desc:
Build the ultimate anime army and crush endless waves of enemies!

⚔️ Summon heroes from anime worlds: Ninja, Pirate and Dragon
👥 Lead up to 125 units that fight by your side
🔥 Clear many story acts and defeat iconic bosses
💀 Take on Raids for rare awakening items
✨ Fuse duplicates and Awaken your Mythics into god-tier warriors
📈 Level up your units, upgrade your army and climb from Easy to Hell
🤝 Play solo or team up with up to 3 friends

New player? You start with 500 gems, enough for your first x10 summon!
